definitions.explanation: The act of looking back on past events or experiences. Often used in the context of exhibitions, memoirs, and reviews.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}を{回顧|かいこ}する。
examples.english: To look back on the past.

examples.japanese: {回顧|かいこ}{展|てん}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a retrospective exhibition.

examples.japanese: {引退|いんたい}した{監督|かんとく}が{自|みずか}らのキャリアを{回顧|かいこ}する{番組|ばんぐみ}が{放送|ほうそう}された。
examples.english: A program was broadcast in which the retired director looked back on his own career.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun and as a suru verb ({回顧|かいこ}する). Commonly appears in cultural contexts — {回顧|かいこ}{展|てん} (retrospective exhibition) is a standard compound. Also used in {回顧|かいこ}{録|ろく} (memoir, reminiscences).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {回顧|かいこ}{展|てん}: retrospective exhibition
- {回顧|かいこ}{録|ろく}: memoir, reminiscences
- {過去|かこ}を{回顧|かいこ}する: to look back on the past
- {一年|いちねん}を{回顧|かいこ}する: to look back on the year

cross_references.description: Homophone. {解雇|かいこ} means dismissal from employment.
